$comment: The axes of the shared internal-reference gate for @cosyte/ncpdp, read by @cosyte/script-utils' internal-refs command. What counts as ours (the prefixes) and what is a standard's own designation (NCPDP-SCRIPT, NCPDP-D.0, X12-837P) is a property of this package. The samples are this repository's measured reference material: NCPDP field references (439-E4, 511-FB), transaction codes and the SYNTH-MSG example ids must never match. SYNTH and PKG are absent from the prefixes on purpose: SYNTH-MSG-0001 is example data and PKG-1 is an HL7 v2 field. The runtime-message samples (warning codes, Telecom field references, a remediated message) came with the string-literal pass from the retired scripts/check-src-strings.mjs.
